description: Rothco's Combat Suspenders are crafted to provide reliable support for the extra weight of your belt-mounted gear, ensuring comfort and stability during tactical and outdoor activities. These suspenders feature 2 inch wide elasticized polyester straps designed to distribute weight evenly and minimize strain on your shoulders. Fully adjustable, they offer a 1-size-fits-all solution for maximum convenience. The suspenders are equipped with 1 inch wide nylon side belt loops and a quick-release buckle, allowing for easy attachment to belts up to 4 inches wide. Whether you're carrying tools, equipment, or accessories, these suspenders offer enhanced stability and comfort, allowing you to focus on the task at hand without discomfort. (Please note: Belt pictured is sold separately.) Trust Rothco's Combat Suspenders to keep your gear securely in place during any mission or outdoor adventure.
